The Oracles Project includes the Game Boy core of mGBA, by Jeffrey Pfau and the mGBA contributors, under the
Mozilla Public License 2.0 (mGBA-LICENSE.txt), and inih, by Ben Hoyt, under the BSD 3-Clause licence
(inih-LICENSE.txt), which mGBA uses.

Their source code, as this application is built from it, is mGBA's commit c3c8e5e813f245028de118a56734e1dc0f35ce2a
(https://github.com/mgba-emu/mgba/tree/c3c8e5e813f245028de118a56734e1dc0f35ce2a) with one change, given beside this
notice in source form (mGBA-boot-rom.patch): one line of src/gb/gb.c that adds the CRC32 of the free CGB boot ROM the
application embeds for mGBA to the boot ROMs mGBA accepts. The part of that source the application builds is also in the folder
third_party/mgba of The Oracles Project's source repository, https://github.com/thibautbus/top.
